name: exclude-fracture
desc: Stop excluding Fracture from the RadImageNet blend. Every top public notebook ships _RAD_EXCLUDE=("Baker's",'Fracture'). An independent audit (dariushafshar) measured Fracture as 4th of 12 in blend lift (+0.0077) while Baker's goes negative on gold-58; flipping only this line scored 0.921 vs 0.920 on the real LB (ref 55654006). +0.001 there, unverified on the 0.941 stack.
